definitions.gloss: stone statue; stone figure; stone sculpture
definitions.explanation: A statue or figure carved from stone. Includes religious statues, monuments, and decorative sculptures.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{石像|せきぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a large stone statue in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入|い}り{口|ぐち}→入り口：02507_iriguchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{狛犬|こまいぬ}→狛犬：07115_komainu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{石像|せきぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Stone statues of guardian dogs stand at the entrance to the shrine.

examples.japanese: {何百年|なんびゃくねん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{造|つく}られた→造る：17751_tsukuru⟧{石像|せきぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{風化|ふうか}→風化：17583_fuuka⟧し⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦なお→なお：00305_nao⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Stone statues made hundreds of years ago still remain, though weathered.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in descriptions of temples, shrines, parks, and historical sites. Japan has many {石像|せきぞう}, including {地蔵|じぞう} (Jizo statues) found along roadsides and in cemeteries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {石像|せきぞう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (a stone statue stands)
- {石像|せきぞう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{彫|ほ}る→彫る：00114_horu⟧ (to carve a stone statue)
- {石像|せきぞう}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{動|うご}かない→動く：00904_ugoku⟧ (to stand motionless like a stone statue)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{銅像|どうぞう}→銅像：14471_douzou⟧: bronze statue — made of bronze rather than stone
- ⟦{仏像|ぶつぞう}→仏像：09638_butsuzou⟧: Buddhist statue — specifically a Buddha figure, of any material
